Container.Name: apotharena-masterserver
Container.Overview: Community master server for Apotheon Arena. Tracks active game hosts for the server browser and shows player-friendly startup and activity logs. Use the companion ApotheonArenaMPpatch on each player's game install to point clients at this server.

Config.Name: Master Server Port
Config.Description: UDP port the master server listens on. Keep 14343 unless every client is patched to use a different master-server port.

Config.Name: Host Timeout Seconds
Config.Description: How long a hosted match can miss heartbeats before it is removed from the browser list.

Config.Name: Log Mode
Config.Description: Use 'player' for friendly startup and activity logs. Use 'debug' to keep those logs and also add packet-level Lidgren troubleshooting output.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Directory shown in startup logs. Relative paths are resolved inside the app folder on both Windows and Linux.

Config.Name: Server Display Name
Config.Description: Name shown in the startup, shutdown, and error banners.
